reviewNotes:
Demo video (recorded on a real iPhone 17 Pro Max running this build's app, controlling an iPhone 13 over the local network): https://github.com/leeguooooo/iphone-use/releases/download/app-review-media/phone-use-remote-demo.mp4

What the app does: Phone Use Remote is a remote control for an iPhone that is driven by iphone-use, an open-source daemon (https://github.com/leeguooooo/iphone-use) the user installs on their own Mac. The user pairs the app with their Mac by scanning a QR code the daemon shows, then the app connects to the Mac over the local network or through the user's own HTTPS tunnel, shows the driven iPhone's live screen (H.264) and sends taps, swipes and text to it. There is no account, no backend run by us, and no data collection.

Changes since the previous review: Guideline 5.2.5 - the app is renamed to "Phone Use Remote"; "iPhone" no longer appears in the app name or subtitle and is used in the description only to say which device the app controls. Guideline 2.1 - the video above shows the full flow on a physical device. Because a real connection needs the user's Mac, the app also includes a built-in demo mode so you can try it without a Mac.

How to review: A real connection needs the user's Mac running the iphone-use daemon, so for review please use the built-in demo: on the first screen tap "Try the demo" (Chinese UI: "试用演示"). The demo plays screens recorded from a real iPhone; the places outlined in blue can be tapped (AirDrop, Picture in Picture, and the back button), and swiping right from the left edge goes back. No account or login is needed. The app collects no data and contacts no server other than the user's own Mac.

en-US.name: Phone Use Remote
en-US.subtitle: Remote for AI-driven phones
en-US.promotionalText: See and control the iPhone your Mac's iphone-use drives: live screen, taps, swipes and typing. Try the built-in demo first, no Mac needed.
en-US.description:
Phone Use Remote is the remote for iphone-use, the open-source tool that lets AI agents and scripts operate a real iPhone from a Mac.

When an agent is working on a phone, open Phone Use Remote to watch what it does, take over with your own taps and swipes, type text into the phone, and hand it back.

• Live screen from the phone your Mac drives
• Tap, long press, swipe and drag, mapped onto the phone's screen
• Type text in any language
• Hand the phone back to its holder in one tap
• Pair by scanning a QR code on your Mac, no typing
• Built-in demo with recorded screens, to see how it works before setting anything up

How it works: install iphone-use on your Mac (one command, see the website), connect the iPhone it drives, then scan the code from the iphone-use page. This app talks only to that Mac on your network.

Privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking. The app collects nothing.
en-US.whatsNew: Adds a Speed / Quality switch for the live picture. Quality shows the phone at full resolution and up to about 50 fps; Speed keeps bandwidth low.

zh-Hans.name: Phone Use Remote
zh-Hans.subtitle: AI 操作手机的遥控器
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 查看并接管 Mac 上 iphone-use 正在操作的那台 iPhone：实时画面、点按、滑动、输入文字。没有 Mac 也能先试用内置演示。
zh-Hans.description:
Phone Use Remote 是 iphone-use 的遥控器。iphone-use 是一个开源工具，让 AI agent 和脚本在 Mac 上操作一台真实的 iPhone。

agent 在手机上干活时，打开 Phone Use Remote 就能看到它在做什么，随时用自己的手指接管、往手机里输入文字，用完再交还。

• 实时查看 Mac 正在操作的那台手机
• 点按、长按、滑动、拖动，准确对应到手机屏幕
• 输入任意语言的文字
• 一键把手机交还给持有人
• 在 Mac 上扫码配对，不用输地址和密码
• 内置演示：播放录好的画面，装好之前先看看怎么用

使用方式：在 Mac 上安装 iphone-use（一条命令，见项目主页），接上它要操作的 iPhone，再扫 iphone-use 页面上的二维码。App 只和你网络里的那台 Mac 通信。

隐私：不需要账号，没有统计，不追踪，不收集任何数据。
zh-Hans.keywords: 遥控,远程控制,手机,自动化,AI,agent,投屏,屏幕,MCP,Mac,测试,UI自动化
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 新增「性能 / 画质」画面切换：画质模式按手机原生分辨率显示，最高约 50 帧，更清楚流畅；性能模式更省流量。
